subject: C-suite synthesis: next steps and unblock items for Innovex pilot
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Torres <michael.torres@innovex.com>, Jenna Park <jenna.park@innovex.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: C-suite synthesis: next steps and unblock items for Innovex pilot

Hi Michael / Jenna —

Thanks again for taking time to walk through Innovex's platform objectives this morning. I wanted to capture the executive-level synthesis and the immediate unblock list so your execs have a concise artifact to circulate. TL;DR: pilot to validate 60% cost reduction in peak inference spend; 95th pct latency target <= 150ms; Security + procurement are gating for a 60-day pilot.

Key outcomes we heard from the call:
- Business outcomes: reduce per-query cost during nightly batch windows by ~60%, increase query throughput for product search without regression in quality, and shorten inference tail latency to improve page-load SLAs for logged-in users.
- Success metrics: 60-day pilot with (1) cost delta report, (2) latency p95 <= 150ms on typical 1024 token workloads, and (3) quality parity measured by reranking precision on your sample set.
- Primary risks: data residency for EU records (Jenna flagged), SOC 2 evidence for logging/audit retention, and integrations effort for your middleware layer.

Procurement / path to pilot:
1) Security questionnaire & evidence mapping (we attached a starting workbook).
2) Pilot SOW (attached v0.2) + mutual NDA already in place; propose MSA signature or short form SOW signature via DocuSign.
3) Pilot provisioning: Redwood Dedicated pool for the pilot (configurable, up to 8 A100-equivalent GPUs) — ops lead (internal) to own cost envelope.

Immediate unblock items / asks from Innovex:
- Security: confirm a primary security contact and any additional evidence beyond SOC 2 / pen test that you'd like us to surface (Jenna).
- Procurement: name/email of procurement contact for contract routing (Michael).
- Technical: share a 1–2GB sample dataset and the expected qps distribution so we can shape the pilot nodes.

What Redwood will deliver by our next checkpoint (target: 48 business hours):
- Updated SOW with pilot sizing and a sample SLA for the pilot (Karthik to own sizing).
- Filled security evidence workbook (Marcus will start mapping).
- Cost delta estimates (ballpark hourly + expected token-unit economics).

Next meeting: propose Tue 04/27 10:00 PT to align procurement path and confirm security checklist. If that doesn't work, suggest a 30-min slot later this week.

Attachments: pilot-statement-of-work-v0.2.pdf, security-evidence-mapping.xlsx

Thanks,

Soojin Lee
Head of GTM Engineering, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: C-suite synthesis: next steps and unblock items for Innovex pilot

+1 on Soojin's summary. I'll draft the pilot sizing and include the dedicated pool configuration options (burst vs reserved) — we can show two cost bands. I can also provision a proof-of-concept pool in our staging region to run a 24-hour load test before the pilot kicks off.

I'll link the sizing doc here once it's live: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-innovex-integration-plan

Karthik
VP, Product Ops — Redwood Inference

From: Michael Torres <michael.torres@innovex.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jenna Park <jenna.park@innovex.com>, procurement@innovex.com, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 11:26:00 -0400
Subject: Re: C-suite synthesis: next steps and unblock items for Innovex pilot

Soojin —

Appreciate the clean summary. A few quick asks from our side to help move procurement: 
- Can you send a 2-slide cost-delta summary (current vs Redwood pilot estimates) we can present to finance?
- Sample pilot SLA (even an internal draft) so our legal team knows the baseline terms.
- Confirm who our billing contact will work with and whether Redwood will accept a PO or prefers DocuSign signature for the SOW.

Jenna and I will introduce our security lead separately (cc'ing procurement for routing). We'll aim to get back with a primary procurement contact by EOD tomorrow.

On the technical ask: we'll share an anonymized 1.2GB sample extract and expected QPS distribution by EOD Monday.

Thanks — looking forward to the Tue 10:00 PT checkpoint.

Best,
Michael
Chief Product Officer | Innovex

Michael / Jenna —

Great, thanks. Quick confirmation of next steps and owners so we have a single source of truth before the Tue checkpoint: 

Action items (owners / target)
- Redwood: update SOW with pilot sizing + sample SLA (Owner: karchik_iyer — deliverable: Tue 04/27 09:00 PT).
- Redwood: pre-fill security evidence mapping (Owner: marcus_lin — deliverable: Wed 04/28 EOD).
- Innovex: security lead intro and procurement contact (Owner: Michael / Jenna — deliverable: Mon 04/26 EOD — noted you will confirm tomorrow).
- Innovex: anonymized sample dataset and QPS distribution (Owner: Jenna — deliverable: Mon 05/03 EOD).

I'll prepare a 2-slide cost delta summary and a short executive one-pager for the pilot; Marcus will add the security mapping notes. I'll also open HubSpot deal DL-2027-0149 and attach the SOW + evidence workbook.

I'll circulate a DocuSign link for the SOW once we agree sizing — if Innovex prefers a PO path instead, confirm the procurement contact and billing cadence and we'll accommodate.

Call reminder: Tue 04/27 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent).

Thanks all — speak soon.

Soojin Lee
